channel.title: Tidy Math Sheets — Thanksgiving Activities for Kids

item.title: Thanksgiving Week Math, Done
item.description: Keep math going through Thanksgiving week with festive, printer-friendly practice. Two-digit addition and subtraction, with and without regrouping, plus Thanksgiving word problems. Every page has an answer key. Low-ink pages that print well at home or school. Instant download: print it tonight, use it tomorrow.
